name: worktrunk

resources.checksum_source: SHA-256 embedded in pinned official cargo-dist installer

notes: Converts the official release cargo-dist shell installer; preserves archive selection, extraction, binary installation and embedded checksum verification.
The documented unmanaged installation option disables PATH editing, receipts and optional self-updater download; installs into the requested ordinary-user prefix.
Original installer is fetched from the pinned official release URL during build rather than vendored. Every resource is pinned; the target still requires the listed extraction tools.

Functional scope is shell integration generation and syntax validation. Worktree operations additionally require Git >= 2.43; Ubuntu 22.04 default Git 2.34 is insufficient and is not claimed supported.
